map.本工具依据约束护理规范整理松紧度评估参考，供床旁核查使用，以每班评估记录为准。: This tool compiles tightness-assessment references per restraint standards for bedside checks; defer to per-shift assessment records.
map.约束带与皮肤之间应能伸入1-2横指为宜。: 1-2 finger-breadths should fit between strap and skin.
map.过松（≥3指）：约束无效，患者可能自行脱出: Too loose (>=3 fingers): ineffective, patient may escape
map.合适（1-2指）：既能有效约束，又不影响血运: Proper (1-2 fingers): effective yet no circulation impact
map.过紧（无法伸入指头）：影响血液循环，可能导致损伤: Too tight (no finger fits): impairs circulation, may injure
map.警告：如发现末梢血运异常（苍白、发绀、发凉、毛细血管充盈＞3秒），应立即松解约束: Warning: on abnormal distal perfusion (pallor, cyanosis, coolness, cap refill >3 s), release the strap at once and report!
map.肢体约束后以一指（成人）可伸入为度，过紧改松。: After limb restraint, one finger (adult) should fit; loosen if too tight.
map.每班查末梢脉搏、皮温与颜色。: Check distal pulse, skin temp and color each shift.
map.小儿用两指或按体重调整。: Children: two fingers or adjust by weight.
map.输入可伸入一指、末梢红润，工具判合适并提示每班查循环，与规范一致。: Input one-finger fits, distal ruddy; tool rates proper and prompts per-shift circulation check, matching standards.
map.发绀、肿胀、脉搏弱，立即松解。: Cyanosis, swelling, weak pulse: release at once.
